lesson: Budget and limit failures. OUTPUT_LIMIT means a tool result exceeded policy maxOutputBytes. INPUT_LIMIT means a resolved task input exceeded that budget. JOURNAL_LIMIT and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED mean the recorded journal had no room left to hold the next receipt, so execution stopped before the effect rather than after it. POLICY_DENIED means the plan named a tool or an effect the policy does not allow, and is raised before any tool runs. None of these indicate a tool defect: they are bounds, so the fix is a smaller input, a narrower request, or a plan split into fewer tasks.
